title: WatchApiLibSources builder
description: Watch a local OpenAPI spec file and regenerate API lib source files via @openapitools/openapi-generator-cli on change

useDockerBuild.description: Should the build occur inside of a docker container

generator.description: The OpenAPITools generator you want to use

additionalProperties.description: The additional properties you want to pass to the generator

globalProperties.description: The global properties you want to pass to the generator

typeMappings.description: What to map OpenAPI types to. E.g. DateTime to Date

sourceSpecPathOrUrl.description: The path (relative to the workspace root) where the source OpenAPI spec file is located at. Must be a local file - remote (http/https) specs are not supported in watch mode

outputDir.description: The path (relative to the workspace root) or URL where the generated OpenAPI file should go to

sourceSpecUrlAuthorizationHeaders.description: A URL-encoded string of name:header with a comma separating multiple values

silent.description: Whether or not to suppress generator output

ignoreList.description: A list of entries to pre-populate .openapi-generator-ignore with
